title: OutputFormatConfiguration

allOf.description: Specifies which serializer to use. You can choose either the ORC SerDe or the Parquet SerDe. If both are non-null, the server rejects the request.

description: Specifies the serializer that you want Kinesis Data Firehose to use to convert the format of your data before it writes it to Amazon S3. This parameter is required if Enabled is set to true.
